story.iWant: centralize secrets and environment-specific configuration via .env files and typed settings
story.soThat: the system is secure-by-default, portable across environments, and aligned with DevOps best practices
story.tasks: - Create env example files at root, apps/api, apps/web - Implement Pydantic BaseSettings in FastAPI - Wire Docker Compose to load root .env - Ensure Next.js uses .env.local vars - Add secrets scanning (gitleaks) and pre-commit hook - Write smoke tests for API /healthz and web API call

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Env templates exist and documented - .env files ignored by Git; no hard-coded credentials remain - Compose loads env; services read config - API uses BaseSettings; web uses env - CI secrets scan configured; minimal smoke tests pass

artifacts.dependencies: - Python: pydantic, python-dotenv (optional) - Node: next, next-auth (optional), dotenv - Tools: gitleaks

story-context.constraints: - No secrets in VCS; .env files not committed - Consistent variable names across services - Keep local dev simple; containers read env without extra tooling
story-context.interfaces: - API: /healthz endpoint returns 200 and includes config-derived OK - Web: fetch to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL for a basic status check

tests.standards: - Pytest for API settings resolution and /healthz - Vitest/Playwright for web env consumption (optional)
tests.ideas: - Add pre-commit CI job for gitleaks on PRs - Add API /config dump in dev-only mode for debugging
